steps.title: Initialize App Metadata
steps.description: Configure basic application information and target system parameters for Todo Pro.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Settings
steps.description: Set up AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, and SDK 34 compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Setup Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure standard launcher activity, app permissions, and the system Material Light theme without Action Bar.

steps.title: Design Layout XML
steps.description: Create the visual structure including Welcome Screen with progress loader, dynamic task list, header stats, and interactive Task Creation modal layout.

steps.title: Define SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Implement SQLite local database within MainActivity for robust task persistence including custom helper methods.

steps.title: Implement Splash Simulated Loader
steps.description: Add a realistic delayed loading screen demonstrating simulated database indexing progress prior to launching main UI.

steps.title: Implement Modern Card Builder
steps.description: Create a dynamic system to render visual task items as styled material card layouts inside Java.

steps.title: Configure Dynamic Filters
steps.description: Allow tasks to be filtered seamlessly in real-time by completion state (All, Pending, Completed) and search query keys.

steps.title: Implement Creation and Update Actions
steps.description: Integrate full CRUD capabilities allowing users to add, edit, toggle completeness status, and permanently remove tasks.

steps.title: Add Color-Coded Priorities
steps.description: Implement colored priority badge indicators for clear prioritization (High is red, Medium is orange, Low is green).

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Backwards Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure that all dynamic behaviors are coded cleanly with anonymous inner classes instead of modern Java 9+ functional parameters.

steps.title: Building Todo Pro
steps.description: Run build pipeline steps to construct the final debug task management application successfully.
